assertion.statement: Every elliptic curve A/Q of arithmetic conductor N is modular and admits a finite surjective Q-morphism X0(N) to A.
assertion.objects: The actual elliptic curve A/Q, its arithmetic conductor N and its conductor-level modular parametrization.
assertion.hypotheses: A is an elliptic curve over Q.
assertion.quantifiers: Every elliptic curve over Q; no semistability, residual-image or non-CM restriction.
assertion.parameter_range: Arithmetic conductor N of the same A, not an arbitrary enlarged level.
assertion.uniformity: Qualitative existence for each A; no effective degree bound.
assertion.normalizations: Published Silverman second edition C.13.6 and C.16.4(a),(c); BCDT attribution retained.
assertion.exceptional_cases: C.16.4(b) Fricke formula excluded. No normalized newform, optimality, Manin constant or Hecke identity inferred.
assertion.limit_order: Choose A and its conductor, then its parametrization before forming later quotient maps.

use.reason: Both the arbitrary forward-rank elliptic curve and the actual RC curve are over Q. The universal published formulation applies directly at their arithmetic conductors.
use.shared_contract_justification: The same universal theorem is instantiated for the arbitrary forward-rank A/Q and the fixed RC E_l/Q. Neither instance needs or supplies the other instance; their later quotient constructions remain distinct.
